about: What sets a premium interior apart

A premium interior is not just more expensive materials — it is precision: joints without gaps, lighting built into the architecture, doors flush with the wall, furniture made to fit every niche. Such decisions are set in the drawings, so the working documentation of a premium project is more detailed than a typical one.

We work on everything from a city apartment to a residence: Linden Penthouse — 210 m² in Kyiv, Hodos Villa — 500 m², houses in Ukraine, the USA and the UAE. On large properties the interior relies on a system: one logic of materials, lighting and joinery across all rooms.
From design to delivery without losses

The costliest mistakes in the premium segment happen between design and construction: a crew simplifies a detail, a supplier swaps a texture, furniture does not fit the niches. That is why we take the project to the end — designer supervision, renovation by our team, procurement and styling.

Furniture, lighting and decor can be ordered directly from factories in China, including custom manufacturing — colour, size, material, finish. Delivery takes 35–70 days, so we order in parallel with the renovation.
How much a premium interior design costs

The design project costs from $30 per m², minimum $2,500. The rate depends on the scope, the number of rooms and the level of detail; we quote the exact price after the brief. A phone consultation is free.

Renovation to the design costs from $550 per m² (works and rough materials; finishing materials, furniture and appliances are estimated separately). For a 200 m² property the base calculation is 200 m² × $30 for design and 200 m² × $550 for renovation. If CAS carries out the renovation, the total stays within ±5% of the estimate.
